description: React component for a request transformation playground, allowing users to input API requests, transform them, and view the results with different view modes.

methods.name: handleTransform
methods.description: Handles the transformation of the API request, setting a sample response.

methods.name: handleCopy
methods.description: Copies the transformed request to the clipboard.

methods.name: renderContent
methods.description: Renders the UI content based on the current view mode.
